answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint identities via cryptographic attestation chains verified through zero-knowledge proofs. Each successive identity in an agent cluster demands exponential capital exhaustion, transforming an attacker's cheap clone garden into a desolate financial tundra. Staking tiers terrace identity creation costs at O(2^n), ensuring superlinear attacker cost wipes out Sybil swarms before profitable coordination.
